Monetary Policy

Current Inflation target

7.0% (±2 percentage points) on average in 2026 Q4

The CBE aims to achieve monetary and banking system soundness and price stability, within the context of the general economic policy of the state, in accordance with the Central Bank and Banking System law no. 194 of 2020. Within its price stability mandate, the CBE is committed to achieve and maintain low and stable inflation over the medium term
